title: Which country will win the men's team gymnastics gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The Commonwealth Games men's team gymnastics competition awards medals according to the final team standings.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Commonwealth Games results, corroborated by contemporary reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the country awarded gold in the men's team gymnastics competition at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, once the final standings are announced. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.
